assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, STAR + RSEM expected counts (mm10, Gencode M17)

treatment: exercised (8 wk treadmill, every 2nd day, 45 min at 50% max)

sample_inclusion: 60 soleus muscle samples: per strain 6 non-exercised + 6 exercised (3 responders + 3 non-responders) (S3.8.1.p1)
primary_estimand: effect of 8-wk endurance exercise training on gene expression, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
repeated_measure_unit: none: one sample per mouse per tissue; independent mice
paper_method: limma-voom, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
paper_results: Soleus (S1.2.1.p1, S1.2.2.p1, S1.2.3.p1, S1.2.4.p1, S1.2.5.p1): B6 no major differences except modest IFN-gamma signaling up; ND5 strongest transcriptional response (OxPhos and stress-response genes up); ND6 no induction of mitochondrial genes; CO1 only a few glycolytic genes up; ANT1 no change in glycolytic genes. No DEG counts in the main text (Datasets S1-S11 not available here).
